logic.note: Each channel lights with forward current through its die to the common cathode.

timing.note: Follows each re-solve; PWM shows as on/off per edge without persistence-of-vision averaging, so mixed PWM colours flicker rather than blend.

analog.note: Three piecewise-linear diodes: red 2.0 V knee, green/blue 2.9 V knee (InGaN), close to typical datasheet Vf. No exponential curve or thermal effects.

power.note: Per-channel over-current warnings at 20 mA and errors at 30 mA; no actual failure.

emulates: Additive colour mix of the three channels
doesNotEmulate: Exact colour gamut and white balance
testOnRealDevice: Colour mixing and white balance (resistor values per channel)
